text: From the blacksmith’s.” “Halloa!” said the sergeant, staring at Joe. “Halloa, Pip!” said Joe, staring at me. “It was some broken wittles—that’s what it was—and a dram of liquor, and a pie.” “Have you happened to miss such an article as a pie, blacksmith?” asked the sergeant, confidentially. “My wife did, at the very moment when you came in. Don’t you know, Pip?” “So,” said my convict, turning his eyes on Joe in a moody manner, and without the least glance at me,—“so you’re the blacksmith, are you?
